full_prompt_en: A square street-art collage shows a huge close female face occupying nearly all of the left two-thirds. She looks upward and toward the right with bright blue irises, heavy black lashes, arched dark brows, and full dark lips. The skin is printed in cream and gritty blue-black halftone rather than smoothly painted. Her blue-black hair sweeps from the top and along the right side in bold directional strands. The right edge of the face cuts across a chaotic wall of older posters, newsprint, comic images, and pasted fragments. Along the top, oversized cropped black-outlined block letters on white ground spell only partial forms; the visible segment reads like HOL, with remaining letters outside the frame. Below, red, beige, black, and faded blue scraps overlap, including tiny printed figures and handwritten-looking marks too small to read. Cracks, tears, seams, and white scuffs travel across the entire surface, even over the face, tying the image to a physical urban wall. The face is crisp at eyes and lips but dissolves into textured print grain at cheeks and neck. Teal-blue accents in hair and eye contrast with brick-red fragments and yellowed paper. The composition is densely cropped and restless, with no empty margin. It feels like layers of visual history have accumulated beneath one dominant image. There is no depicted real room or landscape; the ground is the poster wall itself. No complete coherent sentence can be read from the fragmentary typography. The mood is glamorous yet weathered, combining pop-image immediacy with the abrasion and accidental juxtapositions of street printing.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形街头艺术拼贴把巨大的女子近脸放在左侧约三分之二画幅。她向上偏右望，虹膜亮蓝，黑睫厚重，深眉弯起，嘴唇丰满而深色。皮肤以奶油色和粗粒蓝黑网点印成，并非平滑绘画。蓝黑头发从顶部沿右侧以肯定方向性发丝扫下。脸右缘切入一面旧海报、报纸、漫画图像与粘贴碎片混成的混乱墙。上边有白底黑框的超大残缺块字母，只能读到像 HOL 的片段，余字在画外。下方红、米、黑与褪蓝纸屑互相重叠，含微小印刷人物与像手写的记号，太小不能阅读。裂缝、撕口、拼缝和白擦损越过全表面，连脸上也有，使图像附着在真实城市墙面。眼与唇清脆，脸颊和颈却融入印刷颗粒。发与眼的青蓝重音对照砖红碎片和黄旧纸。构图紧密裁切而躁动，没有空边。像多层视觉历史在一张主导影像之下积累。没有被描绘的真实房间或风景；底子就是海报墙。碎字无法组成完整连贯句子。氛围华丽又磨旧，把波普图像的直接感与街头印刷的磨损、偶然并置结合。
style_prompt_en: The layered street-poster treatment combines high-contrast screen-printed imagery, cropped block typography, comic fragments, torn newsprint, paste seams, and scratches. One oversized clean focal image is interrupted by gritty halftone and physical cracks, while many smaller historical-looking scraps pack the adjacent field. Cream, blue-black, teal, brick red, faded yellow, and dirty white make a restricted urban palette. Lettering is large but cropped and fragmented; tiny secondary marks are visual texture rather than a coherent message. Abrasion and collage overlap create depth on a flat wall surface. Edges alternate between sharply printed contours and ragged paper losses. The result is pop-bright, weathered, and visually busy, with impact built from scale contrast and accumulated layers.
style_prompt_zh: 叠层街头海报处理结合高对比丝网印图、裁断大块字母、漫画碎图、撕破报纸、粘贴拼缝和刮痕。一处过大清楚焦点影像被粗网点与物理裂缝打断，旁边许多较小旧印刷碎片挤满画域。奶油、蓝黑、青绿、砖红、褪黄与脏白组成受限都市色盘。字母虽大却被裁碎，微小次级记号作为视觉纹理而非连贯信息。磨损和拼贴重叠在平墙表面制造深度。边缘在清利印刷轮廓与参差纸损间交替。结果波普明亮又磨旧且忙碌，冲击来自尺度对比和层层积累。
theme_en: A blue-eyed woman's face fills a torn street-poster collage with oversized lettering
theme_zh: 蓝眼女子的脸占满带巨大字母的撕贴街头海报拼贴
name: FAILE
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
